description: The settings window (#1236) only listens: the shell tells it where to go (settings-navigate) and when a shared window ended. It reads the backend through the channels it attaches (backend_attach) and writes through backend_write, which names its requests its own. It sends no events. Its window permissions and the links it may open are the main window's, in vrct_capability.json; the webview's file drops are as the main window's.
